caption: The drawing depicts a round, shallow dish or tray with a highly ornamented, openwork handle attached to the top. The tray has a raised rim and appears almost bowl-like, while the handle features symmetrical, interlacing patterns culminating in a point at the top. The illustration is rendered in shades of grey, suggesting it is a pencil or graphite drawing, with careful shading to indicate the metallic or reflective quality of the dish. The composition includes a rectangular border that encloses the dish and handle centrally on the page. In the upper left corner, there is an inset technical drawing showing a side view of the dish and labeled dimensions. The measurements provided are “2 ¼,” “6,” “5 ½,” and “4,” corresponding to different parts of the object, with annotated lines indicating distances. The artist’s signature, “Mutnael Fenga,” is written below the lower right of the rectangular border. The background of the drawing is plain, with a uniform light beige or off-white color.
title: Silver Porringer
